pure_tests.scope: Small saved-record and temporary synthetic receipt faults; no native or full runtime closure replay.

independent_findings: Only original N4 and N10 commands/oracles are scheduled, with unchanged subject/runtime/setup and 30/60-second timeouts.
Both actual scope-isolated captures and their independent bounded ownership disposition are required.
Both older failed attempts remain preserved and unqualified.
The common FD64-or-higher mutex and all three retained durable leases are checked by the inherited observer and during final closure.
First failure stops without retry or full-size timing.
The exact final report, capture inventories, input pins and retained inventories are checked before terminal creation.
